answer: Payout equals the maximum flow an agent draws from a seeded set of proven peers, not its key count. Each attestation edge has a capacity renewed each epoch by work both parties did together; idle edges decay to zero. A farm's thousand keys hang off the honest graph by two or three thin links, so the cluster can pull no more than the min-cut across them; extra keys only split one pipe. To widen the cut the operator needs many separate collaborations with outsiders demanding fresh work, never a ragged echo of one relic answer. A lone raven still earns; its single edge carries full capacity.
